chapter: With the Goldkette band: Bix and Trumbauer
title: Audiences: college crowds versus ballroom dancers
summary: College students listened closely while ballroom dancers just danced fox trots.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: That's right and as far as the people,

that was something else again. The bands never enjoyed that in those days, seldom, unless you played colleges. Those college kids, they'd be get right up front and listening and listen to the band and talking to the musicians. You'd they'd get a big kick out of that.

But you Id go to a ballroom and never get that. Seldom if ever. The only way you would really appreciate it would be if the crowd got excited and you could feel the pulse and they were in there dancing, but that was when dances got a little bit more active. In those days it was just strictly fox trot.
